seo.title: Contact
seo.description: Talk to Altrazen about a website, an online product, a mobile app, or software that needs taking on. We reply within one working day.

hero.heading: Tell us what you need
hero.description: Or what has already gone wrong. Give us a couple of paragraphs and we will tell you honestly whether we are the right studio, and if we are not, who you should be talking to instead.

form.heading: Send a message
form.successMessage: Message sent. We reply to every message within one working day.
form.errorMessage: That did not send. Nothing you typed has been lost, so try again, or email us directly.

alternatives.heading: What happens next
alternatives.description: We read every message ourselves and reply within one working day. If there is enough to talk about we will suggest a call. If we are not the right fit, we will say so in the reply rather than booking a call to tell you.
